{
 "path": "programs/task-de554c24.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The rare foreground color is the inserted pattern; the most common color is the field.
    color = min((v for v in counts if v != 0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    # Usually the pattern is a single connected component. Recover its shape from all
    # cells of the rare color, preserving offsets even if separated.
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(h):
        for dc in range(w):
            cells = [(dr+sr, dc+sc) for sr, sc in shape]
            if all(0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
"
}
